settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Workspace, uploads, usage tracking and authentication.

general.label: General
general.description: Workspace identity, base URL, default language and time zone.

tracking.label: Usage tracking
tracking.description: Anonymous usage measurement through this server: the browser loads the script from qnop and sends its measurements to qnop, which forwards them. Page addresses are reduced to route patterns first, so no document id ever reaches the backend.

review.label: Review
review.description: Behaviour of the document review workflow.

notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.description: Review e-mails and how long the in-app inbox keeps its records.

banner.label: Info banners
banner.description: Two notices you can switch on: one on the sign-in screens — readable by anyone who can reach this server — and one for signed-in users, which they may dismiss until you change the text.

validation.loginText: Keep it to {{max}} characters — it has to fit above the sign-in form.
validation.appText: Keep it to {{max}} characters — it is one line across every page.

general__application_name.label: Application name
general__application_name.description: Display name of this qnop instance.

general__base_url.label: Base url
general__base_url.description: Public base URL, used in generated links and emails.

general__default_timezone.label: Default timezone
general__default_timezone.description: Default display timezone (IANA id, e.g. UTC, Europe/Berlin), used as the fallback for users without a personal preference.

upload__document_max_file_size_mb.label: Document max file size mb
upload__document_max_file_size_mb.description: Maximum document upload size in megabytes.

upload__attachment_max_file_size_mb.label: Attachment max file size mb
upload__attachment_max_file_size_mb.description: Maximum comment attachment size in megabytes.

tracking__enabled.label: Enabled
tracking__enabled.description: Whether anonymous usage tracking is enabled. Measurement runs through this server, never past it: the browser loads the analytics script from qnop and sends its events to qnop, which forwards them. Visitors never talk to the analytics backend directly.

tracking__provider.label: Provider
tracking__provider.description: Which analytics backend receives the forwarded measurements.

tracking__host.label: Host
tracking__host.description: Base URL of the analytics backend, e.g. https://matomo.internal. Empty uses the provider's own cloud where it has one (Plausible, PostHog, Pirsch); Matomo and Umami are self-hosted and always need this.

tracking__site_id.label: Site id
tracking__site_id.description: The backend's identifier for this site: Matomo idSite, Plausible domain, Umami website id, PostHog project API key, Pirsch identification code.

tracking__respect_dnt.label: Respect dnt
tracking__respect_dnt.description: Load nothing at all for browsers that send Do-Not-Track or Global Privacy Control.

tracking__consent_required.label: Consent required
tracking__consent_required.description: Ask before measuring anything. Off is defensible only where the backend sets no cookies and your legal basis says so — that call is yours, not this server's.

tracking__track_privileged_roles.label: Track privileged roles
tracking__track_privileged_roles.description: Also measure administrators and auditors. Off by default: a handful of privileged people is barely a statistic and very much personal data.

tracking__forward_client_ip.label: Forward client ip
tracking__forward_client_ip.description: How much of a visitor's IP address is passed on to your analytics backend. Anonymised shortens it, so visitors stay countable without being identifiable. Not forwarded means the backend counts everyone as a single visitor. Full sends the exact address, which is personal data — you need your own legal basis for it.

smtp__enabled.label: Enabled
smtp__enabled.description: Master switch for outgoing mail; when off, message sends are skipped.

smtp__password.label: Password
smtp__password.description: SMTP authentication password (stored encrypted, redacted in API).

smtp__encryption.label: Encryption
smtp__encryption.description: SMTP transport encryption: none, starttls (port 587), or tls (implicit SSL, port 465).

smtp__from.label: From
smtp__from.description: Default From address for outgoing mail.

smtp__from_name.label: From name
smtp__from_name.description: Display name used in the From header of outgoing mail.

auth__self_registration_enabled.label: Self registration enabled
auth__self_registration_enabled.description: Whether visitors may register their own local accounts.

auth__self_registration_default_role.label: Self registration default role
auth__self_registration_default_role.description: Global role assigned to self-registered users (ADMIN is intentionally not selectable).

auth__password_reset_enabled.label: Password reset enabled
auth__password_reset_enabled.description: Whether local users may reset their password by email.

auth__password_reset_token_ttl_minutes.label: Password reset token ttl minutes
auth__password_reset_token_ttl_minutes.description: Validity window of a password-reset token, in minutes.

notifications__review_emails_enabled.label: Review emails enabled
notifications__review_emails_enabled.description: Send email notifications for review activity (reviewer added, annotations, replies, status changes).

notifications__retain_days.label: Retain days
notifications__retain_days.description: Days an in-app notification is kept before the Notification sweep deletes it, read or not (0 disables pruning). Only the record of the announcement goes — the review, annotation or comment it points at is untouched.

review__free_reattach_enabled.label: Free reattach enabled
review__free_reattach_enabled.description: Let authors re-position their own annotations even when the placement is healthy (admins always may).

review__finalize_with_open_annotations.label: Finalize with open annotations
review__finalize_with_open_annotations.description: Let the review be finalized while annotations are still open; they are closed automatically with a standard comment.

review__archive_after_days.label: Archive after days
review__archive_after_days.description: Days a completed review stays before it is archived out of the active lists (0 disables auto-archiving).

review__purge_archived_after_days.label: Purge archived after days
review__purge_archived_after_days.description: Days an archived review is kept before it is deleted permanently, including storage objects no other document references (0 disables purging). Irreversible — the Review purge job must be enabled as well.

banner__login_enabled.label: Login enabled
banner__login_enabled.description: Show a banner on the sign-in and other authentication screens. Readable by anyone who can reach this server, signed in or not — never put internal detail here.

banner__login_text.label: Login text
banner__login_text.description: Text of the sign-in banner, e.g. "Demo installation — sign in with demo@qnop.io / demo". Empty hides the banner even when it is enabled.

banner__login_link_label.label: Login link label
banner__login_link_label.description: Optional link shown after the sign-in banner's text; empty means no link.

banner__login_link_url.label: Login link url
banner__login_link_url.description: Where the sign-in banner's link points (http/https).

banner__app_enabled.label: App enabled
banner__app_enabled.description: Show a banner to signed-in users — maintenance windows, a degraded integration, a global problem. Visible only after sign-in, and each user may dismiss it until the text changes.

banner__app_text.label: App text
banner__app_text.description: Text of the in-app banner, e.g. "Maintenance on Saturday 20:00–22:00 UTC; uploads are paused." Empty hides the banner even when it is enabled.

banner__app_link_label.label: App link label
banner__app_link_label.description: Optional link shown after the in-app banner's text; empty means no link.

banner__app_link_url.label: App link url
banner__app_link_url.description: Where the in-app banner's link points (http/https).
